🇦🇷⁉️ #Spalletti would gladly like to test Nico #González, but he is firm on his decision to absolutely leave Turin. #AtléticoMadrid has not yet presented a credible offer and could wait until the very end. Talks could resume, potentially widening the discussion to #Sørloth, but a more collaborative approach will be needed. Meanwhile, #Atalanta is monitoring him.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🔜 "#Terracciano and #Sportiello do not convince #Juventus, which has thus looked abroad for the vice-#Vicario. The club has identified this role in a goalkeeper highly liked by #Massara: #Grabara. The formula is a loan with an option to buy and there is already a total agreement with the Pole, who will sign until 2030 (1+3). The final 'yes' from #Wolfsburg is awaited, but medical examinations should take place on Monday."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
